title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list sorted in non-decreasing order, delete all duplicate nodes such that each distinct value appears only once. Return the head of the resulting sorted linked list.

Modify the list in-place in `O(1)` extra space.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 3000].
The list is guaranteed to be sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Because the list is sorted, all duplicates of any value appear consecutively.
Compare `curr.val` with `curr.next.val`: if equal, bypass `curr.next`; otherwise move `curr` forward by one step.

examples.explanation: Duplicate copies of 1 and 3 are bypassed, leaving [1, 2, 3].
